title: After the Kikuka Sho: Buried Beneath Chrysanthemums

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan wins the Kikuka Sho, while Ines Fujin collapses from exhaustion after crossing the finish line. When she comes to, she laments what happened.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It turns out that when she returned home, she learned that her sisters quit dancing to take over housework duties from their sickly mother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And in an effort to ease her sisters' worries, Ines took on more part-time work and set about trying to change the way she runs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wish she said something, but I assume she kept it all to herself because she didn't want anyone worrying about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But her worries are my worries too. I promise her we'll work something out, and we set the Osaka Hai as our next goal to give ourselves plenty of time.
